My Story... Our Story

2021 – Where It All Began 🌛

It was the year fate played its sweetest tune. A random message, a short reply, and suddenly my life had a little more spark.

You entered like a quiet melody—soft, unexpected, and unforgettable. I still remember our first chats, the late-night talks, and how those silly conversations made me smile so wide.

We didn’t meet physically, but I felt connected in ways I can’t even explain. It was all virtual—but every emotion, every moment felt more real than anything I had before.

I looked forward to every message, every “hi,” every emoji. I felt like I was slowly meeting someone who’d become irreplaceable.

"Appudu... first time ayinappudu... You didn’t tell me your real name or anything about you... Anni fake cheppav 🥲. But... Eppudaithey nannu nammi, when you finally trusted me and told me your real self... Aa moment lo naku ayina feeling... felt like ee whole world gellichenattuvundhi 🌍✨. Inka gurthuvundhi naku...💭❤️"

"Neku gurtundhaaa leda? 🤔 Appudu... first time nenu konni reels chesi neeku pampina vadi ni 😂 Appude nuvvu adigav – 'Baundhi ledha?' 🤭🎬 It was kinda funny... but also special 😄💬"**

2021 was a beautiful introduction—a first chapter to something I never knew I needed so badly.

And now, as I write this, I still smile thinking how it all began… so perfectly imperfect.

We didn’t meet physically, but I felt connected in ways I can’t even explain. It was all virtual—but every emotion, every moment felt more real than anything I had before.

I looked forward to every message, every “hi,” every emoji. I felt like I was slowly meeting someone who’d become irreplaceable.

2022 & 2023 – From Connection to Comfort 🌟

2022 was the year we built something unshakable. You were the person I turned to first—with good news, with worries, with dreams.

Every memory we made that year—whether small or magical—felt meaningful. Our bond felt deeper than anything I had known before.

"Ela antey… ‘Eroju emaindhi?’ ani nuvvu adigina moment nunchi, ‘Inka enti ra?’ ani cheppela varaku… Nuvvu cheppina prati maata, prati silabatam… Your voice… it’s just pure comfort to my soul, ra ❤️✨"

"Every time we talk on call, There’s this unexplainable peace, ra... Like all my problems just vanish. But when the call ends… I’m scared, Scared of returning to a world without you beside me. Ento... mellaga mellaga... ‘Navya’ ane peru kuda... Naku oka emotion ayipoyindhi now. ❤️📱🌙"

Then came 2023, and with it a new level of understanding. We didn’t just chat, we listened. We didn’t just care, we truly felt.

“From 2021 till now, this was the first time… We went silent. No chats… no calls. But it didn’t feel like just a break from you— It felt like a break from my own peace…💔 Back then, you left saying, ‘B.Tech lo phone vastundhi…’ But you never knew, how much I missed you every single day. I was holding on… quietly breaking inside. Still, I never stopped waiting. Because my heart… it trusted your promises more than anything else in this world…❤️‍🔥”

“Aa time lo naaku ardham ayyindhi ra… You’re more than just ‘Sneha’ to me. Eppudu ‘Sneha Sneha’ ani antavu kani… Naku, tana kanna nuvve mundu parichayam ayav ra. Tana tho kanna, naaku netho vunde bond, feeling, and connection —avi anni ekkuvaga vunnayi ra. Nuvvu na life lo oka special place teesukunnaav… kani adhi sneham tho maatram kadhu…❤️”

“Okay… timelines koncham attu-ittu avachu… but the feeling is true ra. Oka roju… suddenly telegram notification vachindhi — ‘This contact just joined Telegram…’ ani. Nuvvu return ayinattu anipinchindi, Ne peru chusi oka second kuda alochinchakunda msg chesa ra. Aa moment lo heart lo chinna hope flash ayindi… Kani appatikey chala jarigipoyindhi… Neeku intha varaku cheppaledhu idhi… So… vinu ra… next page lo motham cheptaa… 💬❤️”

I started feeling like this story wasn’t just mine anymore. It was truly ours.

2024 – Unspoken Promises 💖

Nuvvu vacchey sariki… sneha to love, break-up anni ayipoyi vunnayi. But the truth is… exactly one week before you texted me back, so idhi jargindhi... All was calm—until one day, oka unexpected person… Mutual friend for sneha and me — same inter batch, same bench — suddenly msg chesadu. Vadini ki teliyadu ra… sneha and nenu love lo undeyvalumu ani. So casually chat start ayyindi. But suddenly, vsdu oka line cheppadu — “Maya… sneha and I had a dirty chat.” I was confused. Nenu adigaa — Then he said it straight — “We had a full open, dirty chat... Tanu sudden ga half pic pampi with t-shirt, ‘Ela vundhi? Emi anipistundhi?’ ani adigindhi ra…” “We even talked about kissing and everything… at that night and next day clg lo nenu tani cheek meda kiss chesa ra.." That moment... Phone ventane off chesasa. Mind… blank. Heart… shattered. Breath… paused. And then, silence. That one week... I slipped into full depression… No sleep, no food, no talking. Not a single soul knew what I was going through. Na badha… evariki cheppaluo ardham kaledhu. I didn’t know who to blame… or what to feel. I wasn’t sure if you'd believe me or not. But ra… at that time, every thought was screaming — “I dont want live…” But something deep inside whispered — "No... this is not how it ends." And that’s when… Nuvvu mallii naa life lo dharshanam ivvavu… Like a sign — telling me: “It’s time to move on.” 💔🌙

So ala manam malli full touch lo ki vacham... and at that time, nenu aa phase nunchi bayata vachanu, antey all credits goes to you raa 💙. You completely changed the way I used to think... all those negative thoughts turned into positivity because of you ✨. Maybe nekemi telidhu, but just by talking to you on calls, naa feeling enti ante, I felt like I'm finally on the right path... I even started forgetting my past like it never happened. Felt like a new beginning 🕊. The way you put efforts and gave me so much priority... 🫶 Honestly, nenu eppudu efforts pettadam and priority ivvadam matrame chusaa, but nenu tesukindhi... was only from you at that time. Those days... idi eppudu call chesthundi raa Rey ani wait chese rojulu... they were really special for me 🕰💭.

You stood by me in ways I never had to ask for. Just your presence—digital or emotional—made a difference every single day.

2024 lo… one of the most beautiful moments enti ante… Oka call. Oka simple talk. But for me… a heart-shifting memory. 💬❤️ Appudu nenu chala low lo unna moment… And nuvvu oka gentle tone lo cheppavu: “Maya… as long as I'm your friend, I’ll stay with you.” Aa matalone… 2024 ani bad year ani anukuntunna nenu… Suddenly felt like — “No… this year has a reason to be remembered.” ✨🌿

and aa time lo "naku ne meda feelings kud vachyee telusaa.. entha la antey ee amyiee kosamu emiana cheyali ra aneyy antha la .."

Thank you for staying, for caring, and for loving—even on the days that felt a little harder.

2025 – Right Now, Right Here 🌈

Here we are. Today. Your birthday. And this page is just for you.

I wanted to wrap up this story—not because it’s ending, but because it’s about to grow even more beautiful.

2025 has come… But still… I don’t know how you look… how you smile… how you exist in real. Abhaa… While everyone else spends time with their special ones — talking, meeting, seeing, I’m still here... living inside imaginations and expectations. 🌌🫂 But amidst all this… liked the most from u Is Everyone talking like when they are in some bond with someone like I miss u , I love u, I like u.. Vallu andaru matallu cheputuruu But nuvuu ala kadhu ittuvanti matalu dhhaginchi Efforts pedtavyu raa..A Aa efforts dwaraa aa matalu vunnaa all deep meanings ni convey chestavu and I am also felt like that all words from ur efforts... Seriously I loved it from u Chala rojulu Nenu anukunaa — “Maybe I’m attracted to the way she talks, behaves, and gives importance…” But no… I realized it’s not attraction. It’s addiction… like a sweet, soulful drug. 💊💘 And hey, you know naa opinion gurinchi kadhaa… Nenu girls kanna boys better ani anipistundhi ani cheptaa vuntaa… But after knowing you… My whole feeling changed. Now I silently wish… “If ever I have a daughter, let her carry a heart and soul like you.” 👧🏼🌼

Thank you for existing in my story. Even without meeting you yet, you’ve touched my life more than most ever could. And for that… I’ll always be grateful ra… 💫💌

So ee 5 years lo nuvuu one of the part annadamu kannaa U are the most part is right one.. 💖🌸✨🫂🌍💫

And recently, that call… You spoke like you were in love with me that day. I know it was just a prank, but I felt myself getting tempted. I know it was all in fun, but I couldn’t stop blushing. I know it was just drama, but still… feelings bloomed, dreams and expectations started flowing— a strange kind of sweetness. I know it was just a normal call...
